name: spend-guard
title: Spend guard
description: Pauses the Worker when a Cloudflare usage alert fires. A verified billing usage alert posted to /_lunora/spend-alert sets a flag in an R2 bucket; while it is set, user traffic gets 503 and cron jobs are skipped. Nothing resumes the app automatically.
docs: Wrap the Worker's default export: `export default withSpendGuard(createWorker({ ... }))` (or `withSpendGuard({ fetch, scheduled })` for a hand-written entry), importing it from lunora/spend-guard. Set SPEND_GUARD_SECRET with `wrangler secret put SPEND_GUARD_SECRET`, and create a webhook destination in Cloudflare whose secret is the same value. Point `lunora cloudflare alerts setup --webhook <destination-id>` at it. Resume by deleting the spend-paused object from the SPEND_GUARD bucket. See README.md for the steps and what the pause does not stop.

envVars.name: SPEND_GUARD_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret Cloudflare sends in the cf-webhook-auth header of every alert delivery. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. With no secret set, the receiver refuses every request.
